about.label: About Us
about.h2: Your trusted driving school in the city
about.p1: Orange Fahrschule stands for modern, professional and multilingual driver training. For over 15 years we have guided our students to their driving licence.
about.p2: Our instructors speak German, English and Arabic so you can learn comfortably in your own language.

features.label: Our Services
features.h2: Everything you need to pass your test
features.p: From theory to practice – we offer comprehensive driver training.

items.title: Flexible Scheduling
items.body: Driving lessons on your schedule – mornings, evenings or weekends.

items.title: Intensive Course
items.body: Get your licence fast – our intensive course is perfect for those who want to reach their goal quickly.

items.title: Multilingual Lessons
items.body: Theory lessons in German, English and Arabic.

items.title: Experienced Instructors
items.body: Certified instructors guide you with patience and expertise.

items.title: Modern Vehicles

items.title: Exam Preparation

items.body: The classic licence for passenger cars. Our programme takes you safely through theory and practice.

items.body: Ideal entry without a clutch – especially suited for students who want to learn in a relaxed way.

items.title: Intensive Course
